top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the complete and mature GLP-1 discovery arc, from proglucagon processing and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide through glucose-dependent insulin secretion and extrapancreatic effects to outcome-proven therapies. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov carry the physiology and the active form, and the citation keeps the scope to discovery while naming the therapeutic consequence. P002 is a defensible near-equal because Knudsen's long-acting design was inventive, but it shifts the citation toward drug development; no award is clearly worse given the maturity of the achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; co-authorship with Linnarsson and Frisen does not involve any credited name on this slate
